title: Choose the Menace Agent visual world
question: The roll assigned On-Air Cart Wall. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: On-Air Cart Wall
options.lineage: radio talk-break cart wall and ON AIR tally
options.thesis: Setup is a board of labeled carts you punch in; the live session is an ON AIR strip that feeds the next break.
options.viewport: Normal Mac window as a radio board: carts for KEY, WHISPER, and PERMISSIONS with link rails for ready versus gap, dark ON AIR tally, START as the punch-in cart at the bottom.
options.risk: Radio host energy can feel more DJ than interview candidate if the live strip forgets it is a teleprompter.

raised.raise: Every cart shows a structural link state — unbroken, gapped, or doubled — so missing permission is a broken rail, not a toast.
Wayfinding is reading: every zone carries its literal name, never radio jargon the candidate must decode.
A single tally mark always names NOW — listening versus your turn — the way a chase light owns the beat.
One hard grid, crisp plates, no soft glass mush that reads as AI-overlay default.
The cart frame is the layout grid; state swaps instantly with no decorative ease.
Setup banks sit as sectional mass with deep gaps between carts, not a flat settings list.

options.label: Talent Autocue
options.thesis: The candidate is talent; the overlay is the prompter — high-contrast ready-to-speak lines, chrome dimmed to the edge.
options.viewport: Black hooded setup screen with one large white instruction, KEY and WHISPER as small edge plates, CONTINUE as a tally that lights red.
options.risk: Also the direction most interview-overlay runs land on — familiar and effective, not a failure of nerve.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: First-run is a resumable schedule: numbered lanes tied to defaults by amber link lines you can break and leave broken.
options.viewport: Black glass setup with lanes 01 KEY, 02 WHISPER, 03 PERMISSIONS; unbroken amber means ready, a clean gap means grant access, RESUME CONFIGURATION is the primary.
options.case: Beats the cart wall on product clarity for a gated first-run; loses on audience identification — plant operator, not interview candidate.
options.risk: Reads as industrial SCADA if the playful Menace voice never lands in the copy.

options.label: Industrial Quote Grammar
options.lineage: industrial streetwear with quoted labels and zip-tie tags
options.thesis: Every zone is named in straight quotes; the active cart keeps its orange tag; missing pieces take the hazard stripe.
options.viewport: White stockroom setup: "KEY", "WHISPER", "PERMISSIONS" as quoted plates, orange tag on the step in progress, START as a hazard-edged punch.
options.case: Holds product clarity through literal naming; loses audience identification — warehouse streetwear, not a live interview desk.
options.risk: Fashion-tech energy can drown the teleprompter job if the quotes become costume.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.lineage: surreal cloud quarry of cut weather blocks
options.thesis: Setup as cutting and stacking weather blocks into a temporary session that rains answers.
options.viewport: Pale quarry of KEY and WHISPER blocks with a blue void where permissions are missing.
options.case: Loses both axes: candidates do not identify with weather quarries, and the metaphor hides the gated setup.
options.kept: Sectional mass with deep gaps between banks.

options.label: Rhythm Step Row
options.thesis: Sixteen candy step keys and a chase light turn first-run into a pattern you arm.
options.viewport: A sixteen-step row with the first three steps as KEY, WHISPER, PERMISSIONS and a chase light for live pulse.
options.case: Loses both axes: musician gear, and sixteen steps pad a three-gate setup.
options.kept: A single mark that always names NOW.
options.risk: Toy instrument energy on a high-stakes interview tool.

options.label: Pixorama Metropolis
options.thesis: Hard-pixel city blocks you zoom into for KEY, WHISPER, and the live overlay district.
options.viewport: Isometric city with Menace Agent HQ; zoom into the interview booth block to start.
options.case: Loses both axes: discovery-city play obscures a gated first-run.
options.kept: One hard grid with no soft mush.

options.label: Elbow Panel Console
options.thesis: Pastel elbow frames on pure black turn setup banks into color segments you punch.
options.viewport: Black wall of lilac and peach pills labeled for KEY, WHISPER, PERMISSIONS, gold active segment.
options.case: Loses both axes: sci-fi console costume, and numeric codes hurt clarity.
options.risk: Spaceship AI is the category rut wearing pastel.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark glass AI overlay with one neon accent, executed at full craft as the familiar interview-copilot product.
canonCard.viewport: Compact dark overlay beside the call, API key field, Start Session, subtle glow.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other AI meeting assistant by design.
